articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a reported 3x improvement on graduate-level science benchmarks. The model introduces a new 'deliberative alignment' system that allows it to reason about its own safety constraints in-context, marking a shift in how guardrails are implemented.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro Tops Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro has taken the top position on SWE-Bench Verified and WebArena, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on complex multi-step coding and web-browsing agent tasks. The model's million-token context window and improved instruction following make it particularly effective for repository-scale code understanding and autonomous debugging workflows.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Deployment to Full Assembly Line Operations
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots are now operating across multiple stages of BMW's Spartanburg assembly line, moving beyond the initial pilot of single-station tasks. The robots handle component insertion, quality inspection, and inter-station material transport with a reported 97.3% task completion rate, representing one of the largest humanoid deployments in manufacturing to date.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Disaster Site Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas humanoid navigating a simulated collapsed building environment with fully autonomous perception and path planning, requiring no teleoperation. The system combines a vision-language model for scene understanding with a learned locomotion policy, allowing it to adapt to unstable rubble, narrow passages, and dynamic obstacles in real time.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Enterprise Agentic Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new agentic framework allowing Claude models to autonomously chain tool calls, manage state across multi-turn enterprise workflows, and delegate subtasks to specialized sub-agents. Early enterprise adopters report 40-60% reductions in back-office processing time for tasks like contract review, compliance checking, and data reconciliation across disparate systems.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, delivering an estimated 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over its N2 node. The first customer chips are expected in AI accelerator and mobile SoC products shipping in Q3 2026, continuing the cadence of transistor density scaling that many had predicted would stall.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on 12 logical qubits with error rates below the threshold required for practical quantum error correction, using Quantinuum's trapped-ion H3 processor. This milestone is widely seen as a critical step toward scalable quantum computing, with the team projecting that useful quantum advantage on chemistry problems could be achievable within two to three years.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office has initiated its first formal compliance audits of major foundation model providers under the EU AI Act's general-purpose AI provisions, which took full effect in April 2026. Companies including OpenAI, Google, and Meta are being assessed on transparency obligations, systemic risk evaluations, and energy consumption reporting, setting precedents that will shape global AI governance frameworks.
